items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Hamp would be hollering -- Slam, you know? A little gimmick you might say is the only thing in my eyesight that held him back

ctx.x: And these cats when I got thru playing I'd say "what the hell am I doin' even looking at a piano?" But at that time I had been looking for something else to start with. That's where the guitar came in. So I had heard him first, but I didn't know him. He was with playing with this Adelaide something... Adelaide Hall I think I believe. Whoever it was, that introduced him into New York. And everybody was on his tail. All the piano players was on his case. You know, when they find a new cat come town, that can play,…
Did you rely on sheet music at all?
I had sheet music, but I was looking at the diagrams, it turned out that the diagrams were for ukulele & that didn't work. --- thing was tuned wrong.
